package projection
import("reflect";"testing";"github.com/Yui-Qi-Tang/calx/incidence")
func TestCalxTopologyProjection(t *testing.T){
 s:=snapshot(t,[]byte(graphFixture));g:=s.Graph();var in incidence.Graph
 for _,n:=range g.Nodes{in.NodeIDs=append(in.NodeIDs,n.ID)}
 for _,e:=range g.Edges{in.Edges=append(in.Edges,incidence.Edge{ID:e.ID,From:e.From,To:e.To,Relation:e.Relation})}
 original,err:=Project(s);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};replacement,err:=incidence.Project(in,incidence.Limits{});if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if !reflect.DeepEqual(original.NodeIDs,replacement.NodeIDs)||!reflect.DeepEqual(original.EdgeIDs,replacement.EdgeIDs)||!reflect.DeepEqual(original.Source,replacement.Source)||!reflect.DeepEqual(original.Target,replacement.Target)||!reflect.DeepEqual(original.RelationMasks,replacement.RelationMasks){t.Fatal("topology differs")}
 // Source sidecars and byte identity remain owned by Pouch, not by Calx.
 original.Source=replacement.Source;original.Target=replacement.Target;original.RelationMasks=replacement.RelationMasks
 if _,err:=Reconstruct(original);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
}
